summary: Steep narrow lane edge, No Stopping signed, townhouses 12 m away.
reasons: No Stopping Any Time signs on the stretch
Narrow lane edge, tree-lined, no pull-off

best_section.where: Mid-lane along the tree-lined bank south of the townhouse block

drivers.seclusion: Tree-lined bank on the near side, townhouses 12-20 m across the lane, so it is only moderately private.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane with trees and a bank at the edge; no verge wide enough to pull off.
drivers.traffic: Quiet lane that serves the townhouses and joins a junction.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along the lane.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs 0.1-6.6 m from the line

sun_shade: Heavy shade from tree canopy on the south and west sides.
